limitations: Structural audit-options-colours-coloursets remains Partial and uncounted: native bounded RGB picker differs from QColorDialog HSV/HTML/history/platform topology.
Application Palette, stylesheet/QSS and OS appearance remain separately owned; generic controls and synthetic preview status retain native palette semantics.
Saved role updates are owner-local, weak and at most250ms; arbitrary whole-platform or unrepresented-widget parity is not claimed.

Represented native thumbnail fills/borders map all eight saved-role brushes into the extracted Paint Palette. Current physical storage membership distinguishes local/remote normal/selected paints; palette invalidation clears both current and previous fade snapshots without changing decoded thumbnail bytes/cache entries. The native grid keeps the saved grid role behind viewport margins and the bottom-right background-image layer. This covers represented native grid integration; QColorDialog topology, QSS/OS palettes and unrepresented controls remain outside scope. No dedicated combined saved-role-plus-background-bitmap pixel-parity claim is made.
Linux only at exact9bec source; Windows/macOS deferred. Only this original concrete ID earns credit; no structural parent/alias or unrelated thumbnail-option completion.

Native opening/minimum measurements use physical1x software-rendered client areas. OS compositor minimum enforcement, HiDPI native window behavior and broad font/platform pixel parity are not established.

Qt picker PNG uses19/83/197 and full QColorDialog topology; native picker capture uses the initial255/255/255 role. Qt Colours PNG showsdefault/default, native enabled capture intentionallyshowsdarkmode/darkmode after physical input. These are related different states, not paired bitmap parity.
RGB picker accepted/hidden/retired channel callbacks are verified against staged role values; actual standard SpinBox text-input behavior is not independently exercised here.
Role-paint exports deliberately isolate thumbnail/viewer paint in places; controlled fade-clock and250ms observer evidence do not establish full compositor or arbitrary scheduling parity.

updates.assessment: Independent exact override checkbox gates the thirteen swatches in each editing tab while preserving the current-set selector. Cancel/reopen and field-scoped Apply preserve latest unrelated Help/role changes; imported retained ClientOptions fallback and native precedence persist. Saved override controls the thirteen represented Qt colour roles across owned thumbnail, autocomplete, tagbox, preview/viewer/archive/delete/duplicate consumers while leaving the application Palette/style unchanged. Hidden Options and stale/hidden child callbacks cannot change or save drafts; child rebind/close ownership is retained.
